purpose: Repair the Gekta P0 SPEED read-only model-host diagnostic so it uses the existing least-privilege SSH principal directly, without sudo/root escalation and without changing the service, filesystem, runtime, network or production application.
requiredBehavior: reuse only the dedicated protected model-host SSH identity and pinned host key
run the remote diagnostic as the connected least-privilege SSH principal with no privilege escalation
publish only whitelisted CPU memory process and llama.cpp scheduling fields
never print environment contents credentials raw command line prompt response model bytes or customer data
forbiddenCapabilities: production VPS credentials as fallback model-host authority
sudo su doas or any other privilege escalation
systemctl restart start stop enable disable daemon-reload or edit
file write chmod chown package install or process signal on the model host
printing any secret environment value or arbitrary ExecStart argument
new server paid API SaaS or recurring cost
